items.location: Cumulative moments for limited particle size range
items.anchor_quote: the instrument cannot sense the entire range of the distribution as the theory describes
items.summary: Each moment instrument has a limited particle-size range (some also have inlet impactors that remove larger particles), so it cannot sense the whole lognormal distribution; SAME-R derived an error-function formula for the fraction of each moment an instrument captures between its lower and upper size limits, to improve uncertainty analysis.
